## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): electron n = +3.2×10¹², hole n = −1.2×10¹²

**Raw first, then the FFT/onset read.** Both runs complete, no clipping (sr1 max 12 % FS at 10 T, run 7). Model tone markers from `fs_count_b0` (semi-quantitative — trust topology/partition, not absolute F).

**Read (run 6, electron, F_L = 33.1 T):** oscillations persist to the record's low edge — onset **censored ≤ 0.30 T** (good quantum mobility; 0.30 T is a valid fan B_lo lower bound). Dominant tone **7.1 T** ≈ the model's ABAB light pocket at n = 3.2 (7.31 T, global scale 0.97); tracked content at **22.1 / 29.5 T** is flagged as ≈3×/4× harmonics of 7.1 — but the ABAB heavy tone is expected at 25.8 T and F_L at 33.1, and a single-density record cannot separate "harmonic comb of the light tone" from "real heavy pocket" (the investigation's ratio-screen trap: the ABAB pair ratio drifts through 3× with density — here 3.11). **The fan's n-trajectories decide**: harmonics track k·f_light(n) exactly (10.7 T at n = 2.0), a real heavy pocket follows its own Onsager curve (17.1 T at n = 2.0).

**Read (run 7, hole, F_L = 12.4 T):** onset 0.71 T; tones at ~4.7 / 6.6 / 9.4 T with harmonic cross-flags — the near-CNP close-balanced-pair regime the investigation names as the low-|n| exception, and the hole side is capped at |n| ≤ 1.27×10¹² by the TG −0.3 V validator, below the |n| ≳ 2–3×10¹² design band. **Verdict: the fan goes on the electron side** (higher density reach, censored-low onset, model templates separated). Hole record kept as the h-side consistency point for the final call.

**Handoff to the fan:** B_lo = 0.30 T (censored lower bound), sr1 50 µV / τ = 0.3 s proven (SNR up to ~125), Δ(1/B) ≤ 1/(3·F_L(n_max)) = 0.0101 T⁻¹, uniform-B vs uniform-1/B grid-change reproduction available against these records.

# Runs 6-7: SdH spot checks at D = 0 -- raw, onset, windowed FFT vs model tones
import sys
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import open_run, sdh_onset, sdh_fft, summarize_run

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/hera/measurement_env/hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count")
from fs_count_b0 import abab_fs, abca_mstar

I_BIAS = 10e-9                       # sr1 drive / 100 MOhm
R_FS = 50e-6 / I_BIAS                # 5 kOhm full scale
h_e, e_e = 6.62607015e-34, 1.602176634e-19

fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(13, 11))
for j, (fid, n12) in enumerate(((6, 3.2), (7, -1.2))):
    run = open_run(f"data/{fid}")
    print(summarize_run(run))
    B = run.col("magnet_field"); R = run.col("sr1_X") / I_BIAS
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[o], R[o]
    F_L = h_e / (4 * e_e) * abs(n12) * 1e16
    on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=R_FS)
    print(on.summary()); print()

    # raw (no detrend, no log)
    axes[0, j].plot(B, R, lw=0.6)
    axes[0, j].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="Rxx (Ohm)",
                   title=f"run {fid}: n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0 (raw)")

    # background-subtracted vs 1/B, window above onset (cutoff raised 25%)
    cut = max(on.onset_b * 1.25, 0.38)
    msk = B >= cut
    dR = R[msk] - np.polyval(np.polyfit(B[msk], R[msk], 7), B[msk])
    axes[1, j].plot(1 / B[msk], dR, lw=0.6)
    axes[1, j].set(xlabel="1/B (1/T)", ylabel="dRxx (Ohm)",
                   title=f"detrended (deg 7, B > {cut:.2f} T)")

    # FFT in 1/B + model markers
    freqs, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(cut, B.max()), bg_degree=7)
    sp = spec[0] / spec[0].max()
    axes[2, j].plot(freqs, sp, lw=0.9)
    _, orbs = abab_fs(n12 * 1e16)
    for F, _kf in orbs:
        axes[2, j].axvline(F, color="g", ls=":", alpha=0.8)
    axes[2, j].axvline(F_L, color="r", ls="--")
    axes[2, j].axvline(abca_mstar(n12 * 1e16)[0], color="m", ls="-.", alpha=0.6)
    axes[2, j].set(xlim=(0, 1.35 * F_L), xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="FFT (norm)",
                   title=f"FFT: green=ABAB model, red=F_L={F_L:.1f} T, magenta=ABCA")
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("Take: electron side carries the fan (censored onset <= 0.30 T, tones to 29.5 T);"
      " hole side = low-|n| exception regime, capped at 1.27e12. Fan: e-side, D = 0.")

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side (`landau-fan-vti`), D = 0, n = +1.5 → +3.2×10¹², B 0.3 → 6 T

> **05:28** · landau-fan-vti e-side: D=0, n +3.2->+1.5e12 (101 cols), B 0.3->6.0 T uniform-1/B 316 rows (d(1/B)=0.01005/T, 1/3-Nyquist on F\_L=33.1 T), sr1 50uV, fast\_delay 1.8s (6tau); ends gates 0, B=6 T · **ETA ~00:28 (+1d)** (≈19h)

The stacking call's decisive measurement (investigation Step 4): per-column SdH FFT across density, on the side the spot checks picked. Run 6 (n = +3.2×10¹²) resolved the light tone at 7.1 T (≈ model ABAB light pocket, 7.31 T) with content at 22.1/29.5 T that a single density cannot classify — harmonic comb of 7.1 vs the real ABAB heavy pocket (model 25.8 T) vs F_L (33.1 T). The n-trajectories separate these: harmonics track k·f_light(n) exactly (3×light = 10.7 T at n = 2.0), a heavy pocket follows its own Onsager curve (17.1 T at n = 2.0), an ABCA singleton rides F_L. Hole side excluded: validator-capped at |n| ≤ 1.27×10¹², inside the investigation's low-|n| exception regime — run 7 stands as the h-side consistency record. **Design (computed, model F(n) table + runs 6/7):**

- **B_lo = 0.30 T** — run 6's measured onset (censored at the record edge → valid lower bound; sub-0.3 rows would be bought blind).
- **B rows: uniform in 1/B, 316 rows**, Δ(1/B) = 0.01005 T⁻¹ = 1/(3.0·F_L(n_max)) — 3 samples/period at F_L = 33.1 T, 2.6 at the +15 % lever-arm band edge (38 T); Nyquist limit 49.7 T. Rows concentrate at low B where the periods live (only ~17 rows above 3 T).
- **B_max = 6.0 T** — δF is onset-limited: at n_max δF = 0.31 T; worst column (n_lo, onset ≈ 0.7 per run 7) δF = 0.79 T → 2δF = 1.6 T < the heavy-vs-F_L gap at n_lo (2.0 T). Raising B_max buys almost no δF and only feeds the weak Step-6 ladder — run 6 already covers n = 3.2 to 10 T. Heavy tone (m* ≈ 0.06) is LK-alive above ~2 T at T_e ≈ 8 K, 8.5 periods in-window.
- **n = +1.5 → +3.2×10¹², 101 columns** (Δn = 0.017×10¹²). n_lo floor: below 1.5 the light partner falls under 5 periods in any practical window (3.6 at n = 1.2) — the stated exception regime. n_max = validator edge (V_tg = +0.984, 16 mV margin). Image ray-Nyquist ≥ 2 for B ≥ 0.35 T; per-column FFTs unaffected below.
- **fast_delay 1.8 s = 6τ** (τ = 0.3 s, 24 dB/oct) — per-column FFT carries the signal on the n-axis, so the 4τ Středa dwell is not enough (base step 7). slow_delay 1 s. Sensitivity fixed 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): worst corner (n_min × 6 T) anchored by runs 6/7 ≤ ~600 Ω ≈ 12 % FS — 8× headroom, and this exact setting resolved tones at SNR ≤ 125. Leak guard 1 nA stays on.
- **Price** (calibrated: run 5 fast axis 1.10 s/pt at 1.0 s delay → reads ≈ 0.1 s; runs 6/7 settle+ramp): 316×101 pts × 1.9 s = 16.8 h + row overhead (settle 3 s + flyback ≈ 2.4 s) 0.5 h + 5.7 T ramps 0.7 h = **18.0 h computed → headline ≈ 19 h** (session evidence: actuals run over). **Ends: gates parked at 0, field at 6.0 T** — deliberately left for the LK mass split (Verify: temperature-dependence Flavor B, B window ~2.8–6 T) that follows the fan read.
- **Cost floor**: this is the floored design — B_lo at measured onset, n_max at claim validity, N_n at the F(n)-trace floor (ray floor 0.35 T stated), B_max at claim need. The one non-floor choice is Δ(1/B) at prefer-1/3 rather than 1/2-Nyquist: at 1/2 the F_L tone sits on the Nyquist edge and a +15 % scale error aliases it — not acceptable on the tone the call keys on.

**Checkpoints** (armed `hera-watch data --next --follow`): first rows ~15 min (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field tracking); ~row 60 (≈3.5 h, B ≈ 0.5 T) low-B image sanity — rays present, no rail; ~row 150 (≈8.5 h, B ≈ 0.85 T) partial per-column FFT (δF ≈ 0.67 T) — light-branch f(n) trajectory check, continue/abort; ~row 240 (≈13.5 h, B ≈ 1.6 T) heavy-tone band emerging. Abort criteria: rail, leak trip, or no oscillatory structure at the high-n columns by row 60 (run 6 guarantees it should be there — absence means a gate/cal fault).

# === Landau fan, electron side (`landau-fan-vti`): D = 0, n = +1.5 -> +3.2e12, B 0.3 -> 6 T uniform-1/B ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_hi, n_lo, N_n = 3.2, 1.5, 101                 # 1e12 cm^-2; e-side, D = 0
ns = np.linspace(n_hi, n_lo, N_n)
VV = np.array([calc_gate_voltages(n, 0.0, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"]) for n in ns])
Vtgs, Vbgs = VV[:, 0], VV[:, 1]
assert TG_MIN <= Vtgs.min() and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX, (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max())
assert BG_MIN <= Vbgs.min() and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())
print(f"fast axis: n = {n_hi:+.2f} -> {n_lo:+.2f}e12 ({N_n} cols), Vtg [{Vtgs.min():+.4f}, {Vtgs.max():+.4f}], "
      f"Vbg [{Vbgs.min():+.4f}, {Vbgs.max():+.4f}]; roundtrip n,D @hi = {calc_nD(Vtgs[0], Vbgs[0], CAL['c_tg'], CAL['c_bg'], CAL['n_offset'], CAL['D_offset'])}")

# --- slow axis: uniform in 1/B, 0.3 -> 6.0 T ascending; d(1/B) = 1/(3*F_L(3.2e12)) = 0.01005 /T ---
B_lo, B_hi, N_B = 0.3, 6.0, 316
B_vec = np.round(1.0 / np.linspace(1.0 / B_lo, 1.0 / B_hi, N_B), 4)
assert np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0) and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
d_invB = (1 / B_lo - 1 / B_hi) / (N_B - 1)
print(f"slow axis: B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, {N_B} rows uniform-1/B, d(1/B) = {d_invB:.5f} /T "
      f"(Nyquist limit {1/(2*d_invB):.1f} T; F_L(n_max) = 33.1 T)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan starts at 0.3), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan: 50 uV = 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA (worst corner n_min x 6 T <= ~600 Ohm = 12% FS, runs 6/7 anchor).
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s, slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB/oct; "
      f"fast_delay 1.8 s = 6 tau; drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> 10 nA")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti electron side: D = 0, n = {n_hi:+.2f} -> {n_lo:+.2f}e12 ({N_n} cols), "
                  f"B {B_lo} -> {B_hi} T uniform-1/B {N_B} rows, sr1 50 uV, fast_delay 1.8 s (run-5 cal)")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'electron side, D = +0.00 V/nm: n = {n_hi:+.2f} -> {n_lo:+.2f}e12 cm^-2 ({N_n} cols, paired n-line); '
              f'B {B_lo} -> {B_hi} T uniform-1/B ({N_B} rows, d(1/B) = {d_invB:.5f} /T, Nyquist 1/3 on F_L(n_max) = 33.1 T); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'from spot checks 6 (e-side, onset censored <= 0.3 T) and 7 (h-side)')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs], slow_delay=1, fast_delay=1.8)

# park gates; field stays at 6.0 T deliberately (LK mass split window 2.8-6 T follows the fan read)
s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0.0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0.0)
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T (left at 6 T for the LK ladder), gates parked "
      f"({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
